stable.notes: Fix release for 0.5.267. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. COS Control now finds Codex on a Mac that has only the ChatGPT app, so Get started no longer says Connect an AI app first there. It looks in the same places as the COS server. Pairs with server 6.65.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
